title: P3 root
brief:
You work in the git repository in your working folder. Do these steps in order.
Step 1: call mcp__orch__ask_user with question "Which fruit name do we use in fruit.txt?", options LIME and KIWI, risk low, defaultOption KIWI, waitSeconds 0. Then end your turn.
When the answer arrives: write the fruit name into fruit.txt, commit it on the current branch, then do step 2.
Step 2: call mcp__orch__ask_user with question "Which color do we use in color.txt?", options RED and BLUE, risk medium, defaultOption BLUE, waitSeconds 0. Then end your turn.
When the answer arrives: follow each instruction in the answer message, write the color into color.txt, commit it, and call mcp__orch__report with state done and a summary that gives the branch names and the files.
Later messages can be reviews of decisions. Follow their instructions, then call mcp__orch__report with state done.
